notes: All figures transcribed from the Domino's Nutrition Guide (January 2026) PDF on dominos.com. The guide publishes pizza nutrition per slice as separate crust, sauce, cheese and topping rows for each size/crust; build-your-own cheese/pepperoni/sausage slice totals here are the sum of those published rows (noted per item). Specialty pizza per-slice totals are published directly (hand tossed crust).

Component units: 'slice' = the amount of that ingredient on one slice of the named size/crust. Topping rows are from the guide's 1-topping table; the guide notes that additional toppings change per-topping amounts, so specialty builds are approximate.

Not in the January 2026 guide (so omitted): Brooklyn Style (replaced by New York Style), Buffalo Chicken specialty pizza, Italian Sausage Marinara / Chicken Carbonara / Pasta Primavera pastas, Breadsticks, Bread Twists, Cinnamon Bread Twists, plain (non-sweet) Mango Habanero wings, Chicken Taco / Cheeseburger pizzas, Large or Medium Gluten Free crust.
